notes.total_supply: Every ZCD created by block subsidies up to this height, computed exactly from Zycord's emission parameters.
notes.circulating_supply: Total supply minus the treasury, which is held by the protocol.
notes.founder_allocation: 3% of each block subsidy until height 3,153,600, credited directly to the founder's address. Counted as circulating.
notes.max_supply: None. The decaying schedule issues 61,836,900.03 ZCD up to height 12,602,879; after that a tail of 0.33 ZCD per block continues.
notes.fees: Transaction fees are not part of the subsidy and are not counted.
